schema_note: The frozen scorer schema is reused for the v7 majority-consensus ground truth.
adjudication_rule: A case is positive when at least two of three isolated fix-first reviewers accept it. An exact subject is accepted when at least two reviewers independently accept the same SHA. Unknown cases remain outside the positive denominator.

fix_anchor_correction.reason: The original repair warns but still serves unauthenticated HTTP requests when MCP_BEARER_TOKEN is absent. The corrected descendant makes the token mandatory and exits before serving when it is absent.
fix_anchor_correction.evidence_boundary: The method and B=100 gate remained frozen, but the corrected-root replay was generated after the original schedule seal and is reported as locked-method corrective validation, not as a preregistered blind schedule.

attribution_granularity.claim: Carrier-level observable attribution is accepted by the frozen commit-subject contract but is not presented as atomic or line-level AI authorship.

evaluation_contract.full_inventory_case_complete: Every majority-consensus accepted subject has an exact candidate/fix edge.
evaluation_contract.case_complete_at_budget: Every majority-consensus accepted exact edge is carried by a selected carrier group for that same fix.
